add_definitions(-D__ROS_LONG64__)
spec2def(scrrun.dll scrrun.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
add_idl_headers(scrrun_idlheader scrrun.idl)

list(APPEND scrrun_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scrrun.rgs)

add_idl_reg_objects(scrrun regtypelib scrrun.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# scrrun.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/scrrun-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(scrrun_shims OBJECT dictionary.c filesystem.c scrrun.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(scrrun_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames liboleaut32 libversion libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(scrrun_shims)
add_dependencies(scrrun_shims scrrun_idlheader stdole2)
set(SCRRUN_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/scrrun/scrrun_t.o)
add_cargo_module(scrrun scrrun-cargo scrrun.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS scrrun_shims psdk scrrun_t ${SCRRUN_REUSED} uuid_sources)
